limitations: Typed field contracts are checked against actual serialized value kinds, index ranges and source node families; not every node implementation has been independently disassembled.

Unresolved index domains (ScaleByValue cached node field and autoValueNodeIndices) are preserved, not silently converted to graph links. AnimationSpeed/Direction animData is proven to reference common animation data IDs, not execution nodes.
Local operation roles are per occurrence/path. No global exclusive semantic category is assigned to an animation resource.
Static graph root reachability does not prove runtime branch selection or frame-by-frame contribution.
